usual_baseline: Burden is often scored but rarely acted on. 75.4% of patients with ACB 3 or more had no documented intervention [3536]; 24% with ACB over 3 had no assessment [3428]; no patient needing review had one [3471]. Side effects mentioned in 7.5% and cognition monitored in 44.5% in learning disability teams [3634].
fix_that_works: No fix with measured improvement at re-audit is reported. Only one loop was closed [3388], and it got worse.
fix_that_fails: Unimplemented recommendations from a first audit: patients scoring 0 at 4 weeks fell from roughly 50% to 13%, and more patients had a rising AEC score [3388]. Documented interventions had also declined against earlier local audits [3536].
consultant_advice: The gap is known: scores are calculated but nothing changes. Don't just measure the score again. Build AEC or ACB into the ward-round template or e-prescribing and audit whether a medication change follows a high score.
